frontier-race.status: OpenAI’s GPT‑6.1 Terra and ultra‑fast Decisions API are now generally available, while frontier model training remains offline without live‑internet access. Competing labs have released a wave of new frontier models – Moonshot’s Kimi K3.1 Pro, DeepSeek’s V4.1‑Flash‑1017, Chariot’s multilingual speech model, Block’s local full‑duplex Dessa, and Google DeepMind’s Genie 4 world model – and security‑focused Gemini 4 Carbon is being rolled out to select partners. AI is increasingly being used for high‑impact tasks such as medical diagnosis, academic peer review, formal verification, and large‑scale voice services.
frontier-race.changed: The latest story shows Chinese labs DeepSeek and Moonshot distilling OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra outputs to build their own frontier models, accelerating cross‑border capability diffusion.
